授業科目の概要.授業科目に関する特筆事項:
北海道大学で行われる共同資源工学専攻の講義である。
英語により講義を実施する。日本人学生も、詳細は英語の表記を確認すること。
Held by Hokkaido University.
Microorganisms are sustaining their lives by catalyzing various kinds of chemical reactions in their cells. We can use the attractive function of microorganisms for our rich and comfortable lives. To achieve full potential of microorganisms, we need to understand their intrinsic properties. This course will provide basic and general knowledge of biology including DNA, protein, and microorganisms, covering the concept and the methodology of genetic manipulation. The course contents will be helpful for the application of microorganisms to natural resource development and environment preservation.
Students need to take at least two hours a week for assignments, review, and preparation for each class.

授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（日本語）:
A
Knowledge and Understanding
Students understand the functions of DNA and proteins in vivo, and obtain basic knowledge of genetic manipulation for the purpose of application of microorganisms to natural resource development and environment preservation.
B
Skills and other attributes
Students quantitatively analyze biocatalyses including enzymatic reactions and microbial growth and design appropriate bioprocesses.
C
Transferable Skills
D
Status and Value to Society
Students actively study recent topics on the application of microorganisms to natural resource engineering and environment preservation.
